name: Agility Engineering & Manufacturing Solutions

When you partner with us, you can expect Honest communication, a commitment to innovation that empowers us to Evolve, and an Accountable team that treats all stakeholders with Respect and uses Teamwork to find lasting solutions. about:
Agility Engineering & Manufacturing Solutions is headquartered in St. Paul, Minnesota. Founded in 1952, the company has operated as a 100% employee-owned organization since its inception.

The firm provides electromechanical components distribution, custom manufacturing, and engineering support across the product life cycle—from design assistance to end-of-life management. Its custom capabilities include UL508 panel assembly, wire harness fabrication, and CSA/UL-certified component repackaging, alongside supply chain management services that allow customers to consolidate vendors. The company also operates an online shopping cart stocked with brands such as 3M, Paktron, Mechanical Products, Trumeter, and Solico.

Agility serves manufacturers in agriculture (mobility controls for farm machinery), medical technology (sensing equipment for hospital-grade instruments), and IoT infrastructure. Longtime customers include Brink’s Mfg. Co. and Birk Manufacturing, which rely on the company for critical lifesaving components and competitive pricing.

The company emphasizes its HEART values—Honest communication, Evolution through innovation, Accountability, Respect, and Teamwork—as the foundation of its client relationships. It positions itself on flexibility, speed, and the ability to deliver custom solutions quickly while streamlining fulfillment.
